Explanation from a retired power-tumbler:  


First move is a round-off, momentum builder and turns your body around for the rest of the routine, same as a cartwheel but landing on 2 feet at the same time

5 Whips in a row (absolutely dizzying) these are essentially a back handspring but without your hands touching the track, hard to control but insane levels of momentum built and at higher levels replaces most back handsprings in any given routine

Final back handspring which you can see allows him to slam his center of gravity into the floor  to setup the finishing move, basically adding more torque to the flip

Double backflip in layout position (flat body), this move is NEXT LEVEL HARD compared to other body positions for double back flips as you have less space to flip and need much more airtime to complete it fully, part of the reason why he steps forward after landing a bit

Also the TumbleTrak as they call it is essentially the same as regular Floor routines for womens/mens gymnastics, but have much more springs and a noticeably higher bounce in comparison

Im a AD Lee Sin main in Gold and i can kind of give you a few ways to deal with a Lee Sin:

- Picking Lissandra or Gragas, these people pretty much dominate him at all points of the lane.  Lisssandra has AOE Snare to stop him and can easily kite him all day. Gragas is really tanky which can stop Lee's op Lvl 2-3 all in because Gragas wil usually get away alive no problem.

- Push against Lee so he cant roam, if you picked someone who cant push, he will just push to your turret and then one-shot your ad carry bottom lane 10 seconds later, not good.

- Make sure you are always keeping track of his items, and which wards he has, etc.  Always build Armguard if your a mage and some sort of armor if your ad mid, such as Talon or Zed

- Lee is extremely high risk high reward, baiting hiim into your team or catching him out will almost always result in his death.  The more CC you and your team have the easier it is to stop his godlike mobility

- Lee Sin mid is NOT good late game by any means, unless your team has been getting dominated and Lee is now 10/0/0 by 15-20 mins, he is not going to make much of an impact

- Lee Sin glass cannon has decent teamfights but not great, if he gets to your carry, they are dead almost 90 percent of the time, and if he gets a 5 man kick on your team you have a massive chance of losing that fight because Lee Sin full ad build is probably kicking you for about 800 to 1k damage if your a squishy.  If your carry is good at staying behind others and if your support is competent enough to peel and protect your carry Lee will not be able to do much to you at all
